admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Door note, west stair. The evening carrier will come through the west stair door this week to bring up the kindling. The usual arrangement for the west stair applies, and the duty keeper is to see the carrier through accordingly. The kindling goes to the alcove by the second turn, as before, and the door is to be left as the arrangement provides. Nothing in this note changes who may grant entry at any other door. The duty keeper initials this note each evening the carrier comes.
